blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Modern language models undergo reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) on top of already-trained checkpoints. A key promise of RLVR is the discovery of new reasoning strategies. In principle, a model can sample novel ideas absent from its prior training data. In practice, however, augmenting RLVR with strong novelty incentives has seen limited success and can degrade model quality. Because verifiable rewards supervise only a narrow slice of the model’s knowledge and behavior, such degradations are difficult to recover from. Instead, we decouple exploration from optimization in a framework we call Exploration-Distillation (ExpDis). We train one or more explorer policies with a novelty bonus in the reward, filter their trajectories for correctness and quality, and distill them into a separate student policy. The student policy is then trained without a novelty bonus. We repeat the above procedure for several rounds, alternating between exploration and optimization. This decoupling allows us to aggressively scale exploration without degrading the student policy.
Across seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families, ExpDis outperforms DAPO at the same wall-clock budget. Moreover, we observe improved pass@ k k scaling, indicating that ExpDis produces models that generate more diverse correct solutions. 3 3 3 We release all code and checkpoints .
blocks.zh:
现代语言模式在已经训练有素的检查站之外接受可核查奖励的强化学习。 RLVR的一个关键承诺是发现了新的推理策略. 原则上,一个模型可以对其先前培训数据所缺少的新想法进行抽样。 然而,在实践中,以强有力的新颖激励手段增强RLVR,成效有限,可降低模型质量。 由于可核查的奖励只监督模型知识和行为的一小部分,因此这种退化很难从中恢复. 相反,我们把探索与优化脱钩 在一个我们称之为探索-分裂(ExpDis)的框架。 我们用奖励中的新颖的奖金来培训一个或多个探险家政策,过滤他们的轨迹,使其正确性和质量,并将其分解成单独的学生政策. 学生政策随后在没有新颖奖金的情况下得到训练. 我们重复上述程序几轮,在探索和优化之间交替进行。 这种脱钩使我们能够在不贬低学生政策的情况下大力进行探索。
在七个数学推理基准和两个模范家庭中,Expandis在同一个时钟预算上超过了DAPO。 此外,我们观察到改进了的通过@ k k k 缩放,表明ExpDis产生产生更多样化正确解决方案的模型. 3 3 3 我们解除所有密码和检查站

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the dominant recipe for improving the reasoning abilities of language models [ 19 , 15 , 33 , 26 , 44 ] . RLVR samples solutions to problems, scores each solution with a programmatic verifier, and shifts probability toward those that pass. By iteratively sampling new solutions and reinforcing successful ones, RLVR can in principle discover and then reinforce new solutions that were absent from the model’s training data. In practice, however, it can only reinforce what the model samples, so discovery depends on exploration.
blocks.zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习(RLVR)已成为提高语言模型推理能力的主要方法[19、15、33、26、44]。 RLVR对问题的解决方案进行抽样,对每个解决方案进行程序验证,并将概率转移到那些通过的方案。 通过迭接地取样新的解决办法并强化成功的解决办法,RLVR原则上可以发现并强化模型培训数据所没有的新解决办法。 然而在实践中,它只能强化模型样本的什么,因此发现取决于探索.

blocks.en:
A natural way to boost exploration is to add an explicit novelty bonus to the reward, following a long line of intrinsic-motivation methods in RL [ 30 , 2 , 3 , 10 ] . When the model explores new solution strategies, some of them may succeed but often most of them fail, leading to a temporarily degraded model as we now are left with a model that mostly generates failed solutions.
Though our initial policy is a pretrained LLM with vast knowledge including virtually all of Wikipedia, the reward supervises only a tiny slice of its knowledge. This means an LLM could forget most of Wikipedia and still achieve high reward. The reward therefore cannot detect damage that exploration causes outside that slice, let alone repair such degradations. We argue that this failure is not a property of novelty as a signal, but of where the novelty bonus is applied.
blocks.zh:
一个促进探索的自然方式是,在奖励中增加一个明确的新颖的奖金,在RL [30, 2, 3, 10]中遵循一长串内在动机方法. 当模型探索出新的解决方案策略时,其中一些可能成功,但往往大多失败,导致模型暂时退化,因为我们现在只剩下一个模型,而模型大多产生失败的解决方案.
虽然我们最初的政策是预先训练的LLM, 拥有丰富的知识, 这意味着一个LLM可以忘记大部分维基百科,并且仍然获得高回报. 因此,奖励无法发现勘探活动在该片地外所造成的损害,更不用说修复这种退化。 我们主张,这种失败并不是以新奇为信号的地产,而是适用新奇奖金的地方.

As depicted in the figure, this allows us to explore a diverse set of reasoning strategies and preserve this diversity in our student policy. Because the reward supervises only a narrow slice of the model’s knowledge (here, mathematical reasoning), achieving high reward does not prevent general capability degradation. blocks.en: We decouple exploration and optimization by giving them separate model instances, both trained from the same base checkpoint. An explorer policy explores aggressively under a novelty bonus whose weight λ \lambda sets how strongly it is pushed toward unfamiliar solutions relative to correctness. A separate student policy never sees a novelty reward. It learns from the explorer only through filtered trajectories, and is then trained with standard RLVR. The two models communicate through filtered trajectories rather than parameters, so the student policy absorbs the explorer’s discoveries without inheriting its degradations induced by exploration. We call this framework Exploration-Distillation .
blocks.zh: 我们通过给他们单独的模式实例来解开探索和优化,两者都从同一个基地检查站受训. 探险家政策在新颖的奖金下, 单独的学生政策从不看新颖的奖励. 它只通过被过滤的轨迹向探险家学习,然后被训练出标准的RLVR. 这两个模型通过被过滤的轨迹而不是参数进行交流,因此学生政策吸收了探险家的发现而不会继承由探索所引发的退化. 我们称之为这个框架 探索-分裂。

blocks.en: Decoupling makes exploration safe to scale aggressively, since the student policy never receives the novelty bonus and the filter keeps failed trajectories out of its training data. We can scale breadth by running several explorers in parallel and distilling their pooled trajectories into one student policy. We can also scale depth by repeating the pipeline for multiple rounds that each start from the previous student. We scale both of these axes independently and find that their composition enables sustained performance gains even when all experiments are wall-clock matched.
blocks.zh: 脱钩使得探索安全, 我们可以通过平行运行几个探险家来放大宽度,并将其集合的轨迹提炼成一个学生政策. 我们还可以通过重复管道来扩大深度,使每发子弹都从以前的学生开始。 我们独立地标出这两个轴,发现它们的构成能够持续地提高性能,即使所有实验都是相匹配的。

blocks.en: We evaluate ExpDis on mathematical reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Ministral-3-3B-Instruct-2512 as base models. At the same amount of compute, ExpDis outperforms DAPO in both pass@1 and pass@64. Furthermore, spreading this fixed budget over multiple parallel explorers and several rounds of the ExpDis procedure yields further gains. Adding a novelty bonus directly to DAPO, in contrast, increases diversity but degrades performance on general knowledge benchmarks. In ExpDis, the explorer can be pushed to far higher diversity without harming the student, which improves in both diversity and accuracy and avoids degradation.
blocks.zh: 我们用Qune3–1.7B,Qune3–4B,以及Ministry-3–3B-Instruct-2512作为基准模型来评价数学推理基准的ExpDis. 在同样数量的计算中,ExpublicsDAPO在通过@1和通过@64中都超过了完成. 此外,将这一固定预算分配给多个平行的勘探者和几轮 " ExDIS " 程序将产生进一步收益。 与此相反,直接向DAPO增加一笔新颖的奖金,增加了多样性,但降低了一般知识基准的业绩。 在"ExplosionDis"中,探险家可以被推向更高度的多样性而不会伤害到学生,这既能提高多样性又能提高准确性并避免退化.

blocks.en: In principle, ExpDis is compatible with any exploration mechanism, since the student learns only from the explorer’s filtered trajectories. Since the explorer is never deployed, it can also use mechanisms too aggressive to apply to the deployed model directly. Exploration methods that would destabilize standard RLVR may therefore become viable under ExpDis.
blocks.zh: 原则上,Expandis与任何探索机制相兼容,因为学生只能从探索者的过滤出轨迹学习. 由于探险家从未部署过,它也可以使用过于激进的机制来直接适用于被部署的模型. 因此,在ExDIS下,破坏标准RLVR的勘探方法可能可行。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: A number of works ask whether standard RLVR algorithms discover new solutions or only sharpen a model’s pre-RL generative distribution. Shao et al. [33] observe that RL improves majority-vote accuracy but not pass@ k k , and Chen et al. [5] find that base models overtake their RLVR-trained counterparts at large k k , suggesting that RLVR narrows the set of problems a model can solve. Others find that RL can expand this set through prolonged training [ 25 ] , or that the model learns new skills by composing existing ones [ 45 ] . A related line of work studies entropy collapse: policy entropy falls sharply early in training [ 7 ] , and the gains from RLVR rely on a small set of high-entropy tokens to allow sampling diverse solutions [ 40 ] . Many methods counteract this entropy collapse during training. For example, DAPO [ 44 ] raises the upper clipping bound so that low-probability tokens with positive advantage can grow faster, whereas He et al. [16] directly regulate the policy’s entropy. Other approaches add exploration or novelty bonuses to the reward [ 36 , 11 , 38 , 21 ] . These methods draw on a long line of exploration bonuses in classical RL, including count-based bonuses [ 2 ] , intrinsic curiosity [ 30 ] , and random network distillation [ 3 ] . ExpDis is compatible with a broad spectrum of exploration bonuses, and we try plugging several example bonuses into our framework, observing benefits of exploration in all cases.

blocks.en: A classical precursor that trains a policy to imitate a separate process that finds better solutions is expert iteration [ 1 ] , in which a tree-search expert generates improved moves and a neural apprentice learns to imitate them. Today, distilling reasoning traces from a stronger model is standard practice: DeepSeek-R1 [ 15 ] is distilled into smaller and faster open models, and several works study how to curate reasoning traces to instill reasoning in fine-tuned models [ 43 , 13 ] . When no stronger model is available, a model can instead learn from its own filtered samples, as in STaR [ 46 ] , ReST [ 14 ] , and ReST EM {}^{\text{EM}} [ 35 ] . DeepSeek-R1 fine-tunes its base model on correct traces rejection-sampled from an RL checkpoint before running RL again [ 15 ] , and multi-teacher on-policy distillation methods [ 28 ] distill separately trained specialist models into one model. We similarly distill trajectories from one model into another, but we train our explorer policies from the same base model as our student with the distinct goal of exploration.
blocks.zh: 一个古典的前身是训练一种政策来模仿一个单独的过程来寻找更好的解决方案是专家迭代[1],其中一棵树的研究专家产生改良的动作并有神经学徒学习去模仿. 如今,从更强模型中分馏推理痕迹是标准实践:DeepSeek-R1[15]被分馏为更小更快的开放模型,还有多部著作研究如何将推理痕迹归结为将推理注入微调模型[43,13]. 当没有更强大的模型时,一个模型可以从自己的被过滤的样本中学习,例如STar [46],ReST [14],和ReST EM {}^{\text{EM}} [35]. DeepSeek-R1在再次运行RL前,在RL检查点对正确的痕迹拒绝样本上微调其基础模型[15],多教师政策蒸馏方法[28]将经过单独培训的专家模型蒸馏成一个模型. 我们同样将一个模型的轨迹提炼成另一个模型,但我们将我们的探险者政策从与我们的学生相同的基模型中培养出来,以独特的探索目标.

blocks.en:
Separating exploration from exploitation has a long history in RL: E 3 [ 18 ] keeps separate exploration and exploitation policies and explicitly switches between them, Şimşek and Barto [34] explore with a policy rewarded for improving a separate task value function that never sees this reward, and Go-Explore [ 9 ] first finds high-reward trajectories and then turns them into a robust policy via imitation learning.
In reinforcement learning for LLMs, R 2 PO [ 39 ] trains a residual logit head to diversify within-group outcomes, uses it to sample rollouts for the policy’s GRPO updates, and discards it at inference. In concurrent work, ICE [ 8 ] explores with instruction-conditioned prompts and self-distills correct rollouts into the unconditioned policy. In both, the exploring policy and the student share weights. We instead train the explorer as a separate network and pass only filtered trajectories to the student. This design choice insulates the student from exploration pressures and thus avoids degrading the student.
blocks.zh:
将勘探与开发分离在RL中有着很长的历史: E 3 [18] 保持单独的勘探和开发政策,并在它们之间明确开关, Şimşek和Barto [34] 以政策奖励探索改善单独的任务价值功能,而这个功能从未看到这种奖励,而Go-Explore [9] 首先发现高回报的轨迹,然后通过模仿学习将其转化为强有力的政策.
R 2 PO[39]在强化学习LLMs的过程中,培训一个残余的对数头,使组内的结果多样化,用它来抽样推出政策中的GPRO更新,并推论放弃它. 在同时开展的工作中,ICE [8] 利用附有指导条件的提示进行探索,并自我消化,正确推出无条件政策。 在两者中,探索政策和学生分享权重. 我们把探险家训练成一个单独的网络,只把过滤过的轨迹传给学生。 这种设计选择使学生免受探索压力,从而避免了对学生的贬低.

blocks.en: We now need a method for collecting trajectories generated by the explorer policy to be distilled into the student. We remove any incorrect trajectories, since the point of this rejection sampling step is to insulate the student from any degradations caused to the explorer by novelty pressure. A naive choice would be to take all correct explorer trajectories or a random subset and hand them off, but we find that filtering not only for correctness but also for quality strongly improves performance. A trajectory passes the filter only if (1) its final \boxed{} answer is correct, (2) it terminates within a fixed token budget, and (3) it contains no repetition loops.
blocks.zh: 我们现在需要一种方法来收集探险者政策产生的轨迹,以被分馏入学生. 我们删除任何不正确的轨迹,因为这个拒绝抽样步骤的要点是使学生免受由新颖的压力给探险家造成的任何退化. 一个天真的选择是 取出所有正确的探索者轨迹 或一个随机的子集 把它们交出 但是我们发现 过滤不仅是为了正确 也是为了质量 只有 (1) 其最后的\ boxed QQ 答案正确, (2) 在固定符号预算内终止, (3) 包含不重复循环时, 轨道才会通过过滤器 。

blocks.en: After this filtering, we keep only a single shortest resulting trajectory per problem. Problems that the explorer solves correctly many times therefore do not dominate the student’s training data. We cap the resulting set at 500 trajectories per round. In Appendix E , we ablate our quality filtering procedure.
blocks.zh: 经过过滤后,我们每个问题只保持一个最短的轨道。 因此,探险家多次正确解决的问题并不支配学生的训练数据。 我们以每轮500个轨迹封顶 在附录E中,我们取消了质量过滤程序。

blocks.en: We distill the base policy on the resulting trajectories simply by performing supervised finetuning (SFT) on those trajectories with the standard cross-entropy loss. Following SFT, we train the distilled model with DAPO and the standard correctness-only reward (i.e., no novelty bonus) to obtain the student policy π 1 \pi_{1} , which inherits none of the degradation from exploration pressure. The student both receives the benefit of exploration via distillation, which is off-policy, and also the benefit of on-policy training during its DAPO stage.

blocks.en: 3.1 Parallel Explorer Policies
blocks.zh: 3.1 平行探索者政策

blocks.en: Rather than train a single explorer policy μ \mu , we can train K K independent explorer policies and pool their trajectories before filtering and performing distillation. Compared to the single-explorer variant, training parallel explorers can increase the diversity of trajectories we curate for the student. This diversity increases coverage over solutions and boosts our probability of discovering successful ones.
blocks.zh: 而不是训练一个单一的探险家政策 μ \ mu , 我们可以训练 K 独立的探险家政策, 在过滤和进行蒸馏之前集合他们的轨迹。 相较于单一探索者变体,培训平行探索者可以增加我们为学生所研究的轨迹的多样性. 这种多样性扩大了解决方案的覆盖面,提高了我们发现成功解决方案的概率。

blocks.en: We set the novelty bonus weight λ \lambda identically for all peer explorer policies, as we find little benefit from varying them. In our experiments, we divide compute among explorers, requiring no additional wall-clock time over a single explorer. The more compute a training run uses, the more parallel explorers we expect to be optimal.

blocks.en: 3.2 Iterative Exploration-Distillation
blocks.zh: 3.2 活性勘探-蒸发

blocks.en: We can scale the above method by performing many rounds of alternating exploration and distillation. After producing a student policy, we can use this student as a strong initialization for both the next explorer policy and subsequent student policy. Formally: to train student π t \pi_{t} , we first train one or more explorers μ \mu from π t − 1 \pi_{t-1} , filter the trajectories, distill those trajectories onto π t − 1 \pi_{t-1} via SFT and then perform standard RLVR on the distilled checkpoint without an exploration bonus to produce π t \pi_{t} .
blocks.zh: 我们可以通过进行多轮交替勘探和蒸馏来扩大上述方法。 在提出学生政策后,我们可以将这名学生作为下一个探索者政策和随后的学生政策的有力初始化. 正式地说:为了训练学生 \ t\ pi_{t} 我们首先从 t\ t\ 1\ pi_{t 1} 训练一名或多名探险家 μ\ m , 过滤出轨迹, 通过 SFT 将轨迹蒸馏到 t\ t\ 1\ pi_{t 1} 然后在蒸馏检查站执行标准 RLVR , 没有勘探奖金 \ t\ pi_{t} 。

blocks.en: We partition the training prompts into R R non-overlapping shards 𝒟 1 , … , 𝒟 R \mathcal{D}_{1},\dots,\mathcal{D}_{R} of equal size. As shown in Figure 2 , round r r draws its training prompts from 𝒟 r \mathcal{D}_{r} . Hence, each round pairs a stronger initialization with prompts it has not yet trained on.

blocks.en: Because exploration is split across several rounds, we can set its strength per round through the novelty-bonus weight λ \lambda , which we anneal on a fixed schedule from 0.75 0.75 to 0.25 0.25 over four rounds. This schedule follows the common practice of decreasing exploration pressure as training progresses [ 37 ] . Early rounds, where correct trajectories are still undiscovered, get strong novelty pressure whereas later rounds get lower novelty pressure to consolidate what has been found.
blocks.zh: 由于探索被分成了多轮,我们可以通过新颖的-bonus重量来设定其每轮的强度 \\ lambda,我们按固定的时间表,从0.75 0.75到0.25 0.25,通过四轮进行. 该时间表遵循了随着培训进展而降低勘探压力的通常做法[37]。 早期的弹道,正确的跑道仍然未被发现,则会得到强烈的新颖压力,而后期的弹道则会得到更低的新颖压力来巩固已经发现的东西.

blocks.en: We report performance on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks: AIME24, AIME25, AIME26 [ 29 ] , MATH500 [ 17 , 22 ] , AMC23 [ 29 ] , Minerva-Math [ 20 ] , and GSM8K [ 6 ] . Following the Qwen3 technical report [ 42 ] , sample 64 64 completions per problem (32 for AMC23 and 8 for GSM8K) and report the unbiased pass@ k k estimator for k ∈ { 1 , 2 , 4 , … , 64 } k\in\{1,2,4,\ldots,64\} . GSM8K is close to saturation for all three models, and AMC23 is close to saturation for the Qwen3 models, which leaves little room to compare methods. We therefore focus on the other five benchmarks and report their mean unless noted otherwise.
blocks.zh: 我们报告7个数学推理基准的业绩:AIME24、AIME25、AIME26[29]、MATH500[17、22]、AMC23[29]、Minerva-Math[20]和GSM8K[6]。 在Qwen3技术报告[42]后,抽样每问题64个完成(AMC23为32个,GSM8K为8个),并报告不带偏见的通过@ k k 估计值为 {{ 1, 2, 4,., 64.} k\in\ 1, 2, 4,\ldots, 64}. blocks.en: We additionally study the model’s degradation on a suite of general capability benchmarks: MMLU-Pro [ 41 ] , MMLU-Redux [ 12 ] , and GPQA-Diamond [ 32 ] for knowledge, ZebraLogic [ 23 ] for logical reasoning, and IFEval [ 47 ] for instruction following. This serves as a proxy for capabilities not directly supervised by our training dataset and reward to study the extent to which exploration pressures can degrade a model’s knowledge over time.
blocks.zh: 我们还根据一套一般能力基准研究模型的退化情况:MMLU-Pro[41]、MMLU-Redux[12]、GPQA-Diamond[32]用于知识、ZebraLogic[23]用于逻辑推理以及IFEval[47]用于以下教学。 这可以代替我们的培训数据集没有直接监督的能力,并奖励研究勘探压力在多大程度上会随着时间的推移降低模型的知识。

blocks.en: We compare against three RLVR baselines with a standard correctness-only reward: GRPO [ 33 ] , Dr. GRPO [ 26 ] , and DAPO [ 44 ] . We find empirically that DAPO is the strongest of these baselines and design two extensions: (1) adding a novelty bonus to the reward with λ = 0.5 \lambda{=}0.5 to isolate the effect of decoupling exploration, and (2) running DAPO for 4 × 4\times as many steps.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三个RLVR基线,标准正确性仅为奖励:GRPO [33],GRPO博士 [26],DAPO [44]. 我们从经验上发现DAPO是这些基线中最强的,并设计出两个延长: (1)在奖励中增加一个新颖的奖金,以QQ = 0.5\lambda = 0.5来隔离脱钩探索的效果; (2)将DAPO运行到4×4\的时间,就像许多步骤一样.

blocks.en: We perform 300 steps of RL with 4 prompts per step, each having a group size of 16 and a 32,768 max generation limit. We also study the effect of training DAPO for 4 × 4\times the number of steps to determine if prolonged training allows baselines to catch up [ 25 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们执行300个步骤的RL,每步有4个急速,每个步骤的组大小为16个,最大生成极限为32,768个. 我们还研究培训DAPO对4x4\次次数的影响,以确定延长培训是否允许基线赶上[25]。

When we scale across explorers or rounds, each share is divided evenly among them, while we keep the SFT stage of the student policy two epochs on at most 500 filtered explorer trajectories per round.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: Across all three models, ExpDis outperforms the DAPO baseline in mean accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks (Figure 3 ). A single round of ExpDis already outperforms DAPO trained for 4 × 4\times as many steps. By spreading the same compute over several rounds of alternating exploration and optimization (Section 3.2 ), we observe further gains. All ExpDis runs outperform this prolonged DAPO run in both average performance and pass@ k k up to 64 generations per problem.
blocks.zh: 在所有三种模型中,ExpDis在数学推理基准中平均精确度超过了DAPO基线(图3)。 单回合的"ExpDis"已经超过了DAPO训练的4×4\的分多步. 通过将同样的计算分出几轮交替勘探和优化(第3.2节),我们看到了进一步的收益。 所有 Expendis 运行的性能都超过这种长时间的 DAPO 运行的平均性能和通过@ k k k 每问题最多64代 。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Under a fixed RL compute budget, how we allocate compute impacts downstream student policy performance. We vary the number of explorers and rounds under a fixed compute budget, and find complementary impacts of each scaling axis. Under a fixed budget, adding rounds improves pass@1 more than adding explorers, and combining both gives the largest gains in pass@1 and pass@64. All results are reported on Qwen3-1.7B.
blocks.zh: 图4:根据固定的RL计算预算,我们如何分配计算影响下游学生政策业绩。 我们根据固定的计算预算来改变探险家和子弹的数量,并找到每个缩放轴的补充影响。 在固定预算下,增加轮回比增加探险家多提高出场次数@1,两者结合,在出场次数@1和出场次数@64中收获最大. 所有结果均以Quen3-1.7B报告。

blocks.en: Decoupling lets us scale exploration along two axes: running several explorers in parallel within a round and repeating the ExpDis procedure over several rounds. In Figure 4 , we vary both on Qwen3-1.7B while holding the total budget fixed at 300 RL updates. We observe that depth contributes more to pass@ 1 1 than breadth, though a combination of both improves pass@ k k over either. One interpretation is that the two axes play different roles: each additional round reinforces a progressively stronger student, whereas additional explorers widen the set of problems with correct trajectories and the variety of trajectories that get distilled into the student.
blocks.zh: 脱钩让我们沿着两个轴线进行大规模探索:在一回合内平行地运行几个探险家,并在多回合中重复ExpDis程序. 在图4中,我们在Quen3-1.7B上都有所不同,而总预算则固定在300RL更新. 我们观察到,深度有助于通过@ 1 1 而不是宽度,尽管两者的结合可以改善通过@ k k k。 一种解释是,两轴的作用不同:每多一回合会强化一个逐渐更强的学生,而额外的探险家则会将一系列问题与正确的轨迹和被分解入学生的轨迹相提并论.

blocks.en: At our budget, gains saturate and begin to show signs of regression after three explorers and four rounds. We expect this optimum to shift as the budget grows: with a higher compute budget, longer rounds and larger batch sizes per explorer will have diminishing marginal returns, and we expect the optimal number of rounds and explorers to increase accordingly. Note that we vary breadth and depth at a fixed compute budget; explorers run in parallel, and spreading compute across more explorers adds no wall-clock time. In principle, this parallelization allows practitioners with vast compute access to ramp up the number of explorers at no time cost.
blocks.zh: 在我们的预算中,增收饱和 并开始显示退步的迹象 经过三个探险家和四轮。 我们期望随着预算的增长,这一最佳变化:随着计算预算的提高,每个探险家的轮数和分批量较大的轮数将会减少边际收益,我们期望最佳轮数和探险家数也会相应增加. 请注意,我们在固定的计算预算下,宽度和深度各不相同;探险者平行地运行,在更多的探险者中分散计算,不会增加壁时钟的时间. 原则上,这种平行化使拥有大量计算访问权的从业者可以不花任何时间地提升探险者的数量.

blocks.en: RLVR is known to collapse entropy and sharpen the sampling distribution as training proceeds [ 7 , 5 ] . Counteracting this collapse within a single model requires a delicate balance, since the same model must both explore diverse reasoning strategies but must simultaneously be optimized for correctness and avoiding incorrect solutions. Adding a novelty bonus to DAPO illustrates this trade-off: it increases both lexical and answer diversity relative to standard DAPO, yet slightly reduces mathematical reasoning performance.
blocks.zh: 已知RLVR会随着训练的进行而坍塌Entropy并磨亮采样分布. [7, 5]. 在一个单一模式内防止这种崩溃需要微妙的平衡,因为同一模式既必须探索不同的推理策略,也必须同时优化以达到正确性并避免不正确的解决方案. 在DAPO中加入一款新颖的奖金说明了这种取舍:相对于标准DAPO,它既增加了词汇学上的多样性,也增加了答案多样性,但略微降低了数学推理性能.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Explorer policy can be driven to more diversity without harming the student. Left: We study how explorer policy diversity impacts the downstream student in ExpDis. In general, we find that we can push the diversity of the explorer policy without corrupting the downstream student policy. Since we filter for correctness and quality before distilling, a moderate increase in explorer diversity (for example, lexical diversity) brought on by tuning the novelty bonus weight λ \lambda does not negatively impact the student policy. Similarly, we can increase the explorer token entropy far beyond that of DAPO (+novelty) without incurring downstream reasoning degradation. Right: We find that ExpDis generations contain more semantically diverse mathematical reasoning strategies. We define each diversity metric in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 图5:探索者政策可以推动更加多样化而不会伤害学生. 左边 : 我们研究探索者政策多样性如何影响Expendis的下游学生. 总的来说,我们发现,我们可以在不腐蚀下游学生政策的情况下,推动探索者政策的多样性. 由于我们在蒸馏前过滤正确性和质量,通过调整新颖的奖金重量来适度地增加探险者的多样性(例如词汇多样性)不会对学生政策产生不利影响。 同样,我们可以在不发生下游推理退化的情况下,将探险家的活字形同DAPO(+新颖)的活字形相提并论。 对: 我们发现,ExDis世代包含着更为多样的数学推理策略. 我们在附录D中界定了每个多样性指标。

blocks.en: Diversity and performance are not always complementary; a model may, for example, learn to rephrase the same solution strategy, thereby increasing lexical diversity or entropy without improving pass@ k k . As shown in Figure 5 , DAPO + novelty exhibits higher lexical diversity and token entropy, but regresses on mathematical reasoning compared to the DAPO model. Broadly, we find that we can push the explorer toward far greater diversity than a single model could tolerate while maintaining or improving on downstream accuracy.
blocks.zh: 多样性和性能并不总是互补的;例如,一个模型可能学会重写同一种解决方案策略,从而增加词典多样性或等效性而无需改进通过@ kk. 如图5所示,DAPO + 新颖性表现出了更高的词典多样性和符號 en,但与DAPO模型相比在数学推理上出现了倒退. 广义地说,我们发现,我们可以把探索者推向比单一模式所能容忍的更大的多样性,同时保持或提高下游的准确性。

blocks.en: We run ablations on Qwen3-1.7B to understand whether ExpDis reduces to either (1) distilling unfiltered explorer trajectories and then running RL, or (2) distilling filtered trajectories without running RL afterward. We find that both variants score slightly below DAPO on AIME24, whereas the full procedure scores above it (Appendix E ). Furthermore, keeping only the shortest valid trajectory per problem (i.e., quality filtering) outperforms keeping every correct trajectory. Finally, we replace RND with a kNN-based or an elliptical novelty bonus (the latter adapted from Tuyls et al. [38] ) and find that mean accuracy drops by at most 1.6 1.6 points, and both variants still outperform DAPO (Appendix C.1 ).

blocks.en: A verifiable reward, typically applied to math and code tasks, directly supervises only a narrow slice of a model’s capabilities. In our experiments, DAPO with the RND novelty bonus degrades below the base model on prior capability benchmarks (Section 4 ) despite improving on math (right). Conversely, ExpDis gets the benefits of exploration without degradation. We report results for each general capability benchmark in Figure 12 .
blocks.zh: 可核查的奖励通常适用于数学和代码任务,直接监督的只是一个模型能力的狭小部分。 在我们的实验中,RND新颖性奖金的DAPO在先前能力基准(第4节)的基础上退化,尽管在数学(正确)方面有所改进。 反之,ExDis获得勘探的好处而不退化. 我们在图12中报告每个一般能力基准的结果。

blocks.en: While the drops we observe are modest at our scale, we speculate that larger-scale RLVR runs that apply exploration bonuses directly to the trained model may accumulate substantially larger degradations over time, whereas decoupling avoids this risk of corrupting the deployed model.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们观察到的下降量在我们的规模上是不大的,但我们推测,对训练有素的模型直接适用勘探奖金的更大规模的RLVR运行,可能会随着时间的推移而累积大量退化,而脱钩则能避免这种破坏所部署模型的风险.

blocks.en: We study how the explorer and student policies evolve across several iterations of ExpDis. Figure 7 suggests a simple picture: the explorers repeatedly expand the space of reasoning strategies available to the student, and the student keeps a growing share of that expansion while leaving its costs (reduced pass@ k k and reasoning faithfulness) behind. Within each round, the novelty bonus pushes the explorer entropy and semantic diversity well above the previous student, and subsequent distillation on the shortest correct trajectories contracts them again. We find that both the student’s diversity and accuracy ratchet upward together across subsequent rounds.
blocks.zh: 我们研究探险家和学生政策如何演变 跨越几个迭代 Expendis。 图7给出了一个简单的画面:探险家们反复地拓宽了学生可用的推理策略空间,学生在这种拓宽中保持了越来越大的份额,同时留下了自己的成本(被降低的传球@克克和推理的忠诚度). 在每轮内,新颖的奖金将探险家的 en和语义多样性推向远超前作学生,而后在最短的正确轨迹上进行蒸馏再次与他们签约. 我们发现,学生的多样性和准确性在接下来的几轮中都呈上升趋势。

blocks.en: Furthermore, explorer policies reach roughly the same semantic diversity in every round, but the gap between them and the student they produce nearly closes by the fourth. One explanation is that each round’s explorers start from a stronger student and therefore solve more of the training problems, so more problems contribute a correct trajectory to the distillation set and the student inherits a broader range of the explorer policy’s solutions.
blocks.zh: 此外,探索者政策在每一轮中都达到大致相同的语义多样性,但是它们与它们所产生的学生之间的差距在第四轮时几乎已经拉近了. 一种解释是每一回合的探险家从更强的学生开始,因此解决了更多的训练问题,因此更多的问题为分解集提供了正确的轨迹,学生继承了更广泛的探险家政策解决方案.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: In standard RLVR, exploration is limited by the need to remain correct. ExpDis removes this constraint by moving exploration into a separate policy. Because the explorer is never deployed, it can be rewarded for novelty, pushed to extremes, or discarded after a single round, with only filtered reasoning traces passing to the student. Our work is inspired by humans who experiment with bold new ideas when failure is permitted. We hypothesize that models too need a space to explore, try new ideas, and be allowed to fail.
blocks.zh: 在标准RLVR中,勘探因需要保持正确而受到限制. Expendis通过将探索移入单独的策略来消除这一制约. 因为探险家从未被部署过,所以可以因新颖而得到奖励,被推向极端,或者在一回合后被丢弃,只有被过滤的推理痕迹传递给学生. 我们的工作受到人类的启发,他们在允许失败时,用大胆的新思想进行实验. 我们假设模型也需要一个空间来探索,尝试新的想法,并被允许失败.

blocks.en: Our results suggest that decoupling exploration from optimization improves RLVR even at a small budget, and we expect its importance and the value of exploration to grow as RL is scaled. As models improve, they become proficient at employing the solution strategies they have seen before, and the problems worth training on are increasingly those where correct solutions are rare or depart from the solution strategies the model has already mastered. A model optimized only for correctness may avoid sampling such novel strategies. This problem may be especially true beyond mathematical reasoning, for example in long-horizon agentic tasks, theorem proving, and open-ended scientific problems. Decoupling lets explorers be aggressive, and this aggressive exploration might be necessary in order for models to discover completely new ideas.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,将勘探与优化脱钩,即使在少量预算中也会改善RLVR,我们期望随着RL的扩大,其重要性和勘探价值会增长. 随着模型的改进,它们开始精通于采用它们以前看到的解决方案战略,值得培训的问题越来越多地是那些没有正确解决方案或偏离模型已经掌握的解决方案战略的问题。 仅为了正确性而优化的模型可能避免取样这种新颖的战略。 这个问题在数学推理之外可能特别真实,例如,在长视代理任务、定理证明和开放式科学问题上。 脱钩让探险家具有攻击性,这种侵略性的探索对于模型发现全新的想法可能是必要的.

blocks.en: In our work, we focus our effort primarily on a single novelty bonus and explorers that share the student’s architecture. Under ExpDis, explorers could use different novelty signals or sampling strategies to specialize in different parts of the solution distribution. Because an explorer only has to produce useful traces, the best exploration method under ExpDis may look quite different from the best one under standard RLVR. We speculate that exploration methods previously too destabilizing to apply directly to a trained model may become usable in this setting. ExpDis may unlock new and more aggressive exploration mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 在我们的作品中,我们的努力主要集中于单一的新颖的奖金和分享学生建筑的探险家. 在"ExploDis"下,探险者可以使用不同的新颖信号或采样策略来专门研究溶液分布的不同部分. 由于探险家只需要产生有用的痕迹,ExplosionDis下的最佳探索方法可能与标准RLVR下的最佳方法相去甚远. 我们推测,勘探方法以前破坏稳定,不能直接适用于训练有素的模型。 Expendis可能解锁出新的更积极的探索机制.
